app.name: ConnectSign

diagnostics.assessmentIntro: Assess your front-desk and clinical environment (lighting, framing, background) to ensure optimal sign recognition and effective communication.
diagnostics.requiredError: Please select an answer before continuing.
diagnostics.q1Instruction: Select the primary light direction relative to the signer.
diagnostics.q1Opt1: Clear front lighting on hands and face without glare
diagnostics.q1Opt2: Side lighting with mild cast shadows
diagnostics.q1Opt3: Backlight behind signer or dim room lighting
diagnostics.q2Instruction: How is the signer positioned within the video camera frame?
diagnostics.q2Opt1: Upper body fully visible from waist to head with space for gestures
diagnostics.q2Opt2: Hands visible but occasionally exit frame during wide movements
diagnostics.q2Opt3: Close-up portrait or camera placed too far away
diagnostics.q3Instruction: Describe the environment visible immediately behind the signer.
diagnostics.q3Opt1: Calm, plain neutral wall without moving elements
diagnostics.q3Opt2: Standard office or clinic background with occasional foot traffic
diagnostics.q3Opt3: Busy public hallway with frequent pedestrian movement or complex patterns
diagnostics.q4Instruction: What is the primary setting for this communication session?
diagnostics.q4Opt2: Administrative reception or public service desk
diagnostics.q5Instruction: How should the translation be presented to the hearing participant?
diagnostics.q5Opt1: Visual text on screen + Spoken voice output
diagnostics.statusOptimalDesc: Your communication setting meets all recommended criteria for reliable sign detection and smooth interaction.
diagnostics.statusModerateDesc: Communication is functional. Minor adjustments to lighting and camera angle will enhance stability.
diagnostics.statusNeedsAttentionDesc: Lighting, framing, or visual clutter may reduce recognition accuracy. Review the tips below before starting.
diagnostics.recLighting: Ensure the light source illuminates the signer from the front to eliminate facial and hand shadows.
diagnostics.recFraming: Keep the camera at chest level so both hands remain inside the frame across the full range of signs.
diagnostics.recBackground: Choose a static, clean background to help MediaPipe distinguish hands from surrounding objects.

about.title: About ConnectSign
about.whyText: In Algeria, Deaf people face frequent communication barriers at pharmacies, clinics, and administrative offices without a certified interpreter. ConnectSign serves as an immediate communication bridge.
about.signToLangStep: 1. Camera → 2. Hand & pose landmarks → 3. Temporal sequence → 4. LSA gloss → 5. Spoken sentence
about.langToSignStep: 1. Text/Speech → 2. Normalization → 3. Gloss sequence → 4. Prerecorded sign clips
about.disclaimer: ConnectSign is a communication assistance tool. It does not replace professional interpreters and does not provide medical diagnosis or advice.
about.missionText: Empower Deaf individuals in Algeria with immediate communication independence at pharmacies, clinics, and essential public services.
about.visionText: Build an accessible technological bridge respecting Algerian Deaf culture while transparently recognizing that AI assists rather than replaces certified human interpreters.
about.barriersText: Removing isolation when explaining health symptoms, receiving prescription guidance, or navigating everyday public services.
about.lsaRoleText: ConnectSign is centered around Algerian Sign Language (LSA), recognizing its unique regional vocabulary and specialized clinical expressions.
about.audienceText: Deaf signers, families, caregivers, pharmacists, doctors, healthcare workers, and public intake desks.
about.privacyText: No camera stream or face video is ever stored or transmitted to external servers. All processing runs directly in your browser.
about.limitationMvp: MVP Vocabulary: Currently calibrated on essential clinical phrases and primary healthcare needs ({{count}} signs).
about.limitationInterpreter: Communication Assistance: ConnectSign never replaces a certified human interpreter.
about.limitationDiagnosis: No Medical Diagnosis: The application transcribes and bridges communication and does not produce clinical prescriptions or diagnoses.
